title: Archaeologists: Ancient brewery tended by elite, female brewmasters

passages.quote: The Wari settled the site around A.D. 600 and then departed abruptly around 1000 for reasons that remain mysterious. The archaeological evidence shows that they torched the brewery, then tossed serving pitchers and ceremonial ceramic drinking vessels into the embers.
the 1,000-year-old industrial scale brewery, built by the largest empire to predate the Inca, appeared to be the oldest in the Andes mountains
